title: Quaternary Hermitian codimension-five LCD distance-four exceptions
summary: Decide whether quaternary Hermitian LCD codes of codimension five and minimum distance four exist at five residual lengths.

formal_statement.body: For every $n\in\{37,38,39,40,41\}$, decide whether a quaternary Hermitian LCD code with parameters $[n,n-5,4]$ exists. Equivalently, determine whether $d_4^H(n,n-5)=4$ or $d_4^H(n,n-5)=3$ for each of these five lengths.

scope.domain: Quaternary Hermitian linear complementary dual codes of codimension five
assumptions: The TIT source already bounds the optimum minimum distance to either 3 or 4 at every listed length
scope.unresolved_remainder: All five instances remain open: $[37,32,4]$, $[38,33,4]$, $[39,34,4]$, $[40,35,4]$, and $[41,36,4]$. Later accessible classification results cover different dimensions, and the inaccessible genetic-algorithm paper has no public parameter-level resolution signal for these cases.

progress.summary: The TIT source isolates five quaternary Hermitian codimension-five lengths where the optimum minimum distance remains either 3 or 4.
